title: Raider conversation session archive (schemaVersion 1)
description: Durable prompt/reply transcript of one conversation session (card RAI-036). Writer: ConversationArchive.encodeDocument. The codec ignores unknown extra fields (documented divergence); this schema is the strict reviewer-facing spec.

sessionId.description: Strict single path segment; enforced at the store boundary.

rootId.description: Conversation root that owned the archived turns; never reused after reopen.

turns.description: Strict prompt/reply pairs; pairing is the schema, there is no per-turn role field.
